summary: Stop and queue.sendNow ('abort') now end the wait for a UI action outcome at once: no outcome is written, no continuation starts, the turn ends aborted and the next turn tells the model 'not confirmed'.
howTo: Nothing to change for the fix. Read onUiActionOutcome events with code 'unconfirmed' and reported false as 'the user stopped waiting'. Known limit: the handler gets no signal yet, so a dialog it opened stays open after Stop; if the user confirms there afterwards the app may still carry the action out while the model is told 'not confirmed'. Close or disable such a dialog yourself if that matters (for example when the turn outcome becomes aborted, onTurnEnd). Own chats calling runToolResultUiActions with a signal: it now resolves 'unconfirmed' right after the abort, also while a handler is pending. Changed for clear(), a session switch and unmount while a handler is pending: the chat is no longer busy until the handler settles (isLoading and isSessionChangeBlocked turn false at once); nothing is written and nothing continues, as before. Stop after an outcome was written (initiated during the page-load save) behaves as before; Stop in the same task in which a handler resolves discards that ok (event unconfirmed).
